<select id="selectSourcePage" resultType="cn.iocoder.yudao.module.pms.platform.dal.dataobject.migration.ExternalKeyMappingDO">
        SELECT id,batch_id,source_record_id,result_type,target_context,target_object_type,
               target_table,target_id,target_role,target_sequence,tenant_id,create_time,
               update_time,creator,updater,deleted
        FROM plt_external_key_mapping FORCE INDEX (idx_plt_external_mapping_batch)
        WHERE tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND batch_id = #{query.batchId} AND deleted = 0
        <choose>
            <when test="query.sourceRecordIds != null and query.sourceRecordIds.size() > 0">
                AND source_record_id IN
                <foreach collection="query.sourceRecordIds" item="id" open="(" separator="," close=")">#{id}</foreach>
            </when>
            <otherwise>AND 1 = 0</otherwise>
        </choose>
    </select>

<select id="selectCursorPage" resultType="cn.iocoder.yudao.module.pms.platform.dal.dataobject.migration.MigrationSourceRecordDO">
        SELECT s.*,
               CASE
                   WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM plt_external_key_mapping m
                                WHERE m.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND m.source_record_id = s.id
                                  AND m.result_type = 'MAPPED' AND m.deleted = b'0') THEN 'MAPPED'
                   WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM plt_migration_issue i
                                WHERE i.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND i.source_record_id = s.id
                                  AND i.deleted = b'0') THEN 'ISSUE'
                   WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM plt_external_key_mapping m
                                WHERE m.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND m.source_record_id = s.id
                                  AND m.result_type = 'RETAINED' AND m.deleted = b'0') THEN 'RETAINED'
                   ELSE NULL
               END AS result_type
        FROM plt_migration_source_record s
        WHERE s.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId}
          AND s.batch_id = #{query.batchId}
          AND s.deleted = b'0'
          <if test="query.afterSourceRecordId != null">
              AND s.id > #{query.afterSourceRecordId}
          </if>
        ORDER BY s.id ASC
        LIMIT #{query.limit}
    </select>

<select id="selectClassificationSummary" resultType="cn.iocoder.yudao.module.pms.platform.dal.mysql.migration.query.MigrationBatchClassificationSummary">
        SELECT COUNT(*) AS source_count,
               COALESCE(SUM(has_mapped), 0) AS mapped_count,
               COALESCE(SUM(has_issue), 0) AS issue_count,
               COALESCE(SUM(has_retained), 0) AS retained_count,
               COALESCE(SUM(has_mapped + has_issue + has_retained = 0), 0) AS unclassified_count,
               COALESCE(SUM(has_mapped + has_issue + has_retained > 1), 0) AS conflicting_count
        FROM (
            SELECT s.id,
                   EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM plt_external_key_mapping m FORCE INDEX (uk_plt_external_mapping_result)
                           WHERE m.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND m.source_record_id = s.id
                             AND m.result_type = 'MAPPED' AND m.deleted = b'0') AS has_mapped,
                   EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM plt_migration_issue i FORCE INDEX (uk_plt_migration_issue_key)
                           WHERE i.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND i.source_record_id = s.id
                             AND i.deleted = b'0') AS has_issue,
                   EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM plt_external_key_mapping m FORCE INDEX (uk_plt_external_mapping_result)
                           WHERE m.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND m.source_record_id = s.id
                             AND m.result_type = 'RETAINED' AND m.deleted = b'0') AS has_retained
            FROM plt_migration_source_record s FORCE INDEX (idx_plt_migration_source_cursor)
            WHERE s.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId}
              AND s.batch_id = #{query.batchId}
              AND s.deleted = b'0'
        ) classified
    </select>

<select id="selectVisiblePage" resultType="cn.iocoder.yudao.module.pms.project.dal.dataobject.projectmanual.ProjectMasterDO">
        SELECT p.*
        FROM proj_project p
        WHERE p.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId}
          AND p.deleted = b'0'
          AND p.id IN
          <foreach collection="query.visibleProjectIds" item="projectId" open="(" separator="," close=")">
              #{projectId}
          </foreach>
          <if test="query.projectNameKeyword != null and query.projectNameKeyword != ''">
              AND p.project_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.projectNameKeyword}, '%')
          </if>
          <if test="query.projectCodePrefix != null and query.projectCodePrefix != ''">
              AND p.project_code LIKE CONCAT(#{query.projectCodePrefix}, '%')
          </if>
          <choose>
              <when test="query.status != null and query.status != '' and query.status.matches('S[0-6]')">
                  AND p.current_stage = #{query.status}
                  AND p.lifecycle_status = 'ACTIVE'
              </when>
              <otherwise>
                  <if test="query.status != null and query.status != ''">
                      AND p.lifecycle_status = #{query.status}
                  </if>
              </otherwise>
          </choose>
          <if test="query.signingMethod != null and query.signingMethod != ''">
              AND p.signing_method = #{query.signingMethod}
          </if>
          <if test="query.projectCategory != null and query.projectCategory != ''">
              AND p.project_category = #{query.projectCategory}
          </if>
          <if test="query.implementationMode != null and query.implementationMode != ''">
              AND p.implementation_mode = #{query.implementationMode}
          </if>
          <if test="query.majorProjectLevel != null and query.majorProjectLevel != ''">
              AND p.major_project_level = #{query.majorProjectLevel}
          </if>
          <if test="query.contractNoKeyword != null and query.contractNoKeyword != ''">
              AND p.contract_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.contractNoKeyword}, '%')
          </if>
          <if test="query.departmentId != null">
              AND p.department_id = #{query.departmentId}
          </if>
          <if test="query.companyId != null">
              AND p.company_id = #{query.companyId}
          </if>
          <if test="query.createTimeStart != null">
              AND p.create_time >= #{query.createTimeStart}
          </if>
          <if test="query.createTimeEnd != null">
              AND p.create_time < #{query.createTimeEnd}
          </if>
          <if test="query.closeTimeStart != null">
              AND p.project_close_time >= #{query.closeTimeStart}
          </if>
          <if test="query.closeTimeEnd != null">
              AND p.project_close_time < #{query.closeTimeEnd}
          </if>
          <if test="query.refreshTimeStart != null">
              AND p.project_refresh_time >= #{query.refreshTimeStart}
          </if>
          <if test="query.refreshTimeEnd != null">
              AND p.project_refresh_time < #{query.refreshTimeEnd}
          </if>
          <if test="query.agentServiceProviderKeyword != null and query.agentServiceProviderKeyword != ''">
              AND EXISTS (
                  SELECT 1 FROM proj_project_party pp
                  WHERE pp.project_id = p.id
                    AND pp.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId}
                    AND pp.deleted = b'0'
                    AND pp.status = 'ACTIVE'
                    AND (pp.effective_from IS NULL OR pp.effective_from <= #{query.effectiveAt})
                    AND (pp.effective_to IS NULL OR pp.effective_to > #{query.effectiveAt})
                    AND pp.party_role IN ('AGENT', 'SERVICE_PROVIDER')
                    AND (pp.party_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.agentServiceProviderKeyword}, '%')
                      OR pp.party_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.agentServiceProviderKeyword}, '%'))
              )
          </if>
        ORDER BY p.id DESC
    </select>

<select id="selectParticipantFacts" resultType="cn.iocoder.yudao.module.pms.project.dal.dataobject.projectmanual.ProjectMemberAssignmentDO">
        SELECT id, project_id, user_id, member_role, assignment_type, version, tenant_id

        WHERE tenant_id = #{query.tenantId}
          AND project_id = #{query.projectId}
          <if test="query.subjectUserId != null">
              AND user_id = #{query.subjectUserId}
          </if>
          <choose>
              <when test="query.requiredRoleCodes != null and !query.requiredRoleCodes.isEmpty()">
                  AND member_role IN
                  <foreach collection="query.requiredRoleCodes" item="roleCode" open="(" separator="," close=")">
                      #{roleCode}
                  </foreach>
              </when>
              <otherwise>
                  AND 1 = 0
              </otherwise>
          </choose>
          AND (member_role = 'PROJECT_MANAGER' OR assignment_type = 'PRIMARY' OR assignment_type IS NULL)
          AND authorization_confirmed = b'1' AND status = 'ACTIVE'
          AND deleted = b'0'
          AND (effective_from IS NULL OR effective_from <= #{query.effectiveAt})
          AND (effective_to IS NULL OR effective_to > #{query.effectiveAt})
        ORDER BY user_id, member_role, id
    </select>
